##### Hello from `_quarto-include-demo.qmd` {#include-demo}
This heading and paragraph live in a separate file. By the time Pandoc sees the document, though, they are simply part of `quarto.qmd`: the heading has an anchor in this page's namespace (it is a level-5 heading, so it sits below this site's `toc-depth` of 4 and stays out of the sidebar table of contents), and a link such as [back to the include shortcode](#include-shortcode) resolves against the host's anchors, because there is only one document.

::: {.callout-tip title="Rendered by the host"}
This callout was written in the fragment and styled by the host page. The fragment has no front matter, no format, and no theme of its own.
:::
